$comment: HO-862: the one declaration of a web-page visual artifact's rules. Read by farm/visual_page.py (the static checks, the capture's viewports and CSP, the stored names) and by server/src/visualPages.js and server/src/app.js (the /page route's CSP and the shot route's name check), so the page an agent's JS runs in on the farm is the page owners get, and a name the farm stores is always one the server serves. `csp` has `sandbox allow-scripts` and never `allow-same-origin`: agent JS runs in an opaque origin with no Horizon session, cookies or API access. `fulfilUrl` is the fixed URL the capture worker answers from the page text; `.invalid` never resolves, so it is never fetched.
csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:; sandbox allow-scripts
